data.reason: Independent manual content review of this standalone artifact against every retained original requirement.
data.rationale: The supplement teaches split-before-feature decisions, training-only median/minmax/category fit, unchanged training statistics under altered validation input, and independent code repair plus leakage-versus-validation-overfitting comparison. This makes the retained assessment dimension met in this standalone material design. The original principle still explicitly requires train-only mean/standard-deviation z transformation, and the practice requires train-only versus all-data mean-centering; this supplement refers to the main notebook for standardization rather than implementing those operations itself. Broad D06 therefore remains gap in this separate artifact, without cancelling the main notebook progress.
